mapper.sql: up.id AS id, up.user_id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, up.org_id AS org_id, o.name AS org_name, up.position_type AS position_type, up.position_address AS position_address, up.position_phone AS position_phone, up.show_order AS show_order, up.remark AS remark, up.ext1 AS ext1, up.ext2 AS ext2, up.ext3 AS ext3, up.ext4 AS ext4, up.ext5 AS ext5, up.ext6 AS ext6, up.ext7 AS ext7, up.ext8 AS ext8, up.ext9 AS ext9, up.ext10 AS ext10, up.status AS status, up.create_by AS create_by, up.create_time AS create_time, up.update_by AS update_by, up.update_time AS update_time
FROM tab_user_position up LEFT JOIN tab_user u ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN tab_org o ON o.id = up.org_id
